population.span: STAREE enrolled people aged ≥70 years from 1583 general practices across Australia with no history of clinical cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or dementia.

endpoint.span: a composite of death from cardiovascular causes, nonfatal myocardial infarction or stroke, or coronary revascularization (to assess effects on major cardiovascular events)

treatment_strategy.span: Participants will be randomly assigned to oral atorvastatin (40 mg daily) or matching placebo (1:1 ratio).

follow_up.span: After a median of 5.9 years, a primary cardiovascular event had occurred

absent_reason: analysis_set: The protocol specifies planned intention-to-treat analyses, but no held results source explicitly confirms the analysis population used for this reported estimate.
served_mismatch: The served effect, CI and HR scale match the results abstract. However, served_outcome.estimand specifies RR; the reported estimate is HR. The served ITT designation is supported only as a protocol plan, not explicitly confirmed for the reported result.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The whole trial enrolled adults aged ≥70 years without clinical cardiovascular disease.
entry_population_matches_question.span: STAREE enrolled people aged ≥70 years from 1583 general practices across Australia with no history of clinical cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or dementia.

notes: The results abstract supplies the effect and its endpoint definition, including coronary revascularization. The earlier protocol and baseline full text omit revascularization from the cardiovascular composite; their endpoint definitions were not substituted for the definition accompanying this estimate. Treatment strategy is protocol-supported. No registry spans were needed.
